name: 71. Bedrock tool search routes Claude to InvokeModel (#6825)
description: Follow-up to #6825: Anthropic server-side tool search (tool_search_tool_regex / tool_search_tool_bm25 plus defer_loading on function tools) is InvokeModel-only on AWS ("On Amazon Bedrock, server-side tool search is available only through the InvokeModel API, not the Converse API", https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/tool-search-tool). Bifrost used to strip the tool and defer_loading for bedrock/ models because its Bedrock provider only spoke Converse; it now routes such requests to InvokeModel / InvokeModelWithResponseStream. The cases pin the behaviour through the response: the deferred get_weather tool must be discovered through tool search and actually called (a tool_use / function_call named get_weather; a search alone is not enough, and neither is an unnamed tool call). Gateway 5xx fails these cases; 503 and 529 are skipped only when the body names a provider capacity condition. When the gateway has client_config.allow_per_request_raw_override enabled, x-bf-send-back-raw-request additionally exposes the outbound body and the cases assert the InvokeModel shape plus the tool_search tool, defer_loading and the tool-search-tool-2025-10-19 beta on the wire. Case 1 is the native /anthropic/v1/messages ingress, case 2 its streaming variant, case 3 the /v1/responses ingress with the neutral "tool_search" tool type. The Claude API accept-path for tool search lives in folder 12.
